title: Benchmark process duration is not active model work
decision: Capture monotonic host process elapsed time separately from trial duration; retain activeWorkMs as null until host wait intervals can be measured. Do not infer approval or network waits from silence.
historicalRationale: The existing preparation-to-evaluation duration includes queue and approval delays. A process stopwatch removes outer delays but cannot identify internal waiting, so calling it active work would create a misleading benchmark claim.
